dataset.description:
The goal of the project is to investigate the world practice of using non-financial performance indicators (NFPIs) and disclosure of information on medium-sized production companies in four statistical regions of Latvia. This project aims to support medium-sized enterprises in this area by developing a tailored methodology for assessing NFP. 

The data set will store the anonymised Delphi method results and expert survey data on non-financial performance representing manufacturing in four of Latvia's regions.

distribution.title: The aim of the data acquisition is to analyze non-financial performance from experts in industry and government. The data will be acquired via the Delphi method and expert survey.

dataset.title: Enhancing Performance Beyond Numbers: Evaluating Non-Financial Performance Indicators in the Manufacturing Sector in Latvian Regions

dmp.description:
The purpose of the Data Management Plan (DMP) is to contribute to the efficient collection, storage, analysis, and sharing of data at all stages of the research grant project implementation while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical requirements. It is a document that forms the basis for organizing and managing data to successfully achieve the goal of the research grant project and its activities.
The goal of the project is to investigate the world practice of using non financial performance indicators (NFPIs) and disclosure of information on medium-sized production companies in four statistical regions of Latvia. This project aims to support medium-sized enterprises in this area by developing a tailored methodology for assessing NFP.
It is planned to publish scientific articles in internationally recognized journals and to prepare and submit an international research project proposal.
The DMP is going to ensure the quality, availability, and sustainability of the data while contributing to achieving the goal of the project and increasing the impacts of the project results in both the scientific and practical fields.
The data management plan is developed within the project No 5.2.1.1.i.0/2/24/I/CFLA/003 "Implementation of consolidation and management changes at Riga Technical University, Liepaja University, Rezekne Academy of Technology, Latvian Maritime Academy and Liepaja Maritime College for the progress towards excellence in higher education, science and innovation" funded by the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility
